raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Problem

`deepseek-ai/dflash_qwen3_4b_block7` (DFlash, `markov_rank == 0`) and
`deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_4b_block7` (DSpark) ship the **same** architecture,
`Qwen3DSparkModel`, and `Qwen3DSparkForCausalLM` serves both -- its Markov head is a no-op
at rank 0.

`SpeculativeConfig` infers the method from the draft **name** before looking at the
architecture, so a `dflash_*` checkpoint gets `method="dflash"`, is EAGLE-renamed to the
unregistered `DFlashQwen3DSparkModel`, and the engine refuses to start. Explicit
`method="dflash"` takes the same path.

Fixes #49614.

## Fix

Route a `dflash` method (explicit or name-inferred) to the dspark path when the draft ships
a self-contained Qwen3 DSpark architecture (`Qwen3DSparkModel`, `Qwen3OmniDSparkModel`).
Standalone DFlash drafts, which have their own registered architecture, are untouched.

## Reproduction

1x H100 80GB, vLLM `0.32.1rc1.dev161+gb272cff36` (commit `b272cff368`); `# Now` is that
same build plus this diff. Local model paths are rewritten to `/models/...` in the logs
below; nothing else is edited. The directory basename matters -- the method is inferred
from the `dflash` in it. Each server below was started on its own free `$PORT`.

```bash
MODEL=/models/Qwen3-4B                 # snapshot of Qwen/Qwen3-4B
DRAFT=/models/dflash_qwen3_4b_block7   # snapshot of deepseek-ai/dflash_qwen3_4b_block7

vllm serve $MODEL --served-model-name Qwen3-4B --max-model-len 4096 \
  --gpu-memory-utilization 0.60 --port $PORT --host 127.0.0.1 \
  --speculative-config "{\"model\":\"$DRAFT\",\"num_speculative_tokens\":7}"
```

## Problem

`deepseek-ai/dflash_qwen3_4b_block7` (DFlash, `markov_rank == 0`) and
`deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_4b_block7` (DSpark) ship the **same** architecture,

architecture, so a `dflash_*` checkpoint gets `method="dflash"`, is EAGLE-renamed to the
unregistered `DFlashQwen3DSparkModel`, and the engine refuses to start. Explicit
`method="dflash"` takes the same path.

files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""DFlash-named Qwen3 DSpark drafts must take the dspark path (#49614)."""
+
+import pytest
+
+from vllm.config.model import ModelConfig
+from vllm.config.parallel import ParallelConfig
+from vllm.config.speculative import (
+    SpeculativeConfig,
+    _route_self_contained_qwen3_dspark_draft,
+)
+
+# All repos are public; only config/tokenizer-config files are fetched.
+QWEN3_TARGET = "Qwen/Qwen3-4B"
+DFLASH_DRAFT = "deepseek-ai/dflash_qwen3_4b_block7"  # Qwen3DSparkModel, markov_rank=0
+DSPARK_DRAFT = "deepseek-ai/dspark_qwen3_4b_block7"  # Qwen3DSparkModel, markov_rank=256
+
+
+def _speculative_config(model: str, method: str | None) -> SpeculativeConfig:
+    return SpeculativeConfig(
+        target_model_config=ModelConfig(QWEN3_TARGET, max_model_len=2048),
+        target_parallel_config=ParallelConfig(),
+        model=model,
+        method=method,
+        num_speculative_tokens=7,
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("method", ["dflash", None])
+def test_dflash_named_qwen3_dspark_draft_is_served_by_dspark(method: str | None):
+    """Explicit and inferred ``dflash`` both resolve to the dspark path."""
+    speculative_config = _speculative_config(DFLASH_DRAFT, method)
+    assert speculative_config.method == "dspark"
+    assert speculative_config.draft_model_config.architectures == ["Qwen3DSparkModel"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+def test_dspark_draft_is_unchanged():
+    speculative_config = _speculative_config(DSPARK_DRAFT, "dspark")
+    assert speculative_config.method == "dspark"
+    assert speculative_config.draft_model_config.architectures == ["Qwen3DSparkModel"]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.cpu_test
+def test_standalone_dflash_draft_is_unchanged():
+    """A standalone DFlash draft has its own registered architecture."""
+    assert (
+        _route_self_contained_qwen3_dspark_draft(
+            "dflash", ["DFlashDraftModel"], "z-lab/Qwen3.5-9B-DFlash"
+        )
+        == "dflash"
+    )

@@ -92,6 +92,42 @@
 _QWEN3_OMNI_DSPARK_ARCHITECTURE = "Qwen3OmniDSparkModel"
 _MUSE_SPARK_DSPARK_ARCHITECTURE = "MuseSparkDSparkModel"
 
+# DFlash and DSpark Qwen3 drafts ship the same architecture; the DSpark model
+# class serves both, since markov_rank == 0 makes its Markov head a no-op.
+_SELF_CONTAINED_QWEN3_DSPARK_ARCHITECTURES = frozenset(
+    {
+        "Qwen3DSparkModel",
+        _QWEN3_OMNI_DSPARK_ARCHITECTURE,
+    }
+)
+
+
+def _route_self_contained_qwen3_dspark_draft(
+    method: SpeculativeMethod | None,
+    draft_architectures: list[str],
+    model_name: str,
+) -> SpeculativeMethod | None:
+    """Serve a dflash-named self-contained Qwen3 DSpark draft with dspark.
+
+    "dflash" would EAGLE-rename the draft to an unregistered "DFlash<arch>".
+    """
+    if method != "dflash":
+        return method
+    matched = _SELF_CONTAINED_QWEN3_DSPARK_ARCHITECTURES.intersection(
+        draft_architectures
+    )
+    if not matched:
+        return method
+    logger.info_once(
+        "Draft model %s ships the self-contained %s architecture; using "
+        "speculative method 'dspark' instead of 'dflash' (the DSpark "
+        "implementation serves markov_rank == 0 DFlash checkpoints too).",
+        model_name,
+        ", ".join(sorted(matched)),
+    )
+    return "dspark"
+
+
 # Draft architectures that carry an XPress refiner. EAGLEConfig rewrites a dflash
 # draft's architecture to DFlash{arch}, so a checkpoint is seen under either name;
 # the dispatch in v1/worker/gpu/spec_decode reads this same set.
@@ -1441,6 +1477,14 @@ def __post_init__(self):
                         f"Unsupported speculative method: '{self.method}'"
                     )
 
+                # A "dflash" method here, explicit or inferred from the model
+                # name, would break these drafts at load time.
+                self.method = _route_self_contained_qwen3_dspark_draft(
+                    self.method,
+                    self.draft_model_config.architectures,
+                    self.draft_model_config.model,
+                )
+
                 if self.method in ("eagle", "eagle3"):
                     # EAGLE drafts share the target's positional space; a
                     # draft checkpoint with a smaller max_position_embeddings
